transcript_only_text:
One  of  the  things  I  thought  was  genius 
 about  like  Yogurt  Land,  if  you  go  to  a 
 store  and  then  they  fill  up  your  stuff 
 behind  the  counter  and  then  they  say, 
 "Hey,  it's  eight  bucks."  You're  like, 
 "Man,  what  the  hell?  This  place  is  so 
 expensive."  But  if  they  give  you  the  cup 
 and  you  fill  it  up  and  you  put  it  on  the 
 scale,  you're  like,  "Man,  I'm  a  fat 
 ass."  Same  pricing,  but  because  I  had 
 control  over  what  I  picked,  I'm  the  one 
 who's  responsible  for  the  decision.
